description:
FILED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress board census: Test::More's `eq_set` is not implemented by PCL's TAP layer (cl/pcl-test.lisp has eq_array / eq_hash; %test-more-stash-install lists eq_set and leaves it absent).

REPRO: use Test::More; ok(eq_set([1,2],[2,1]), "s"); done_testing;
perl: ok 1 - s / 1..1.   PCL: "Undefined subroutine &main::eq_set called" (the file dies).
perl's eq_set: true when the two array refs hold the same elements regardless of order (it sorts both and compares with eq_array; duplicates count).  A missing value-producing function: implement it beside pl-eq_array (rule 12: never a stub).
REACH: IO-Compress t/004gziphdr.t:333 (444 ok then the die; 919 planned).
subject: Test::More eq_set is not implemented by the TAP layer -- "Undefined subroutine &main::eq_set" (IO-Compress 004gziphdr.t dies at row 450 of 919)
